question: Which of the following state won the maximum number of silver medals in the 2015 National Games of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala** won the** maximum number** of **silver medals** in the **2015 National Games of India.**
 
• Kerala won a total of** 55 silver medals **in the 2015 National Games.
 
• **Goa **won a total of** 8 silver medals **in the 2015 National Games.
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** won a total of **25 silver medals** in the 2015 National Games.
 
• **Haryana** won a total of **23 silver medals **in the 2015 National Games.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kerala **is known for its **strong sporting culture **and has consistently performed well in various** national and international** sports events.
 
• **Goa **is a **popular tourist destination** and has a **vibrant culture**, but it is not known for its** sporting achievements.**
 
• **Madhya Pradesh** has made significant progress in developing its **sports infrastructure** in recent years and has produced some talented athletes.
 
• **Haryana** is known for its **wrestling culture** and has produced several Olympic medalists in wrestling.
 
 
• However, in the 2015 National Games, it** did not perform **as well as Kerala, Madhya Pradesh, or some other states.
 
 
 
• Hence, the** correct **answer is option 1, Kerala.
